note: Wooded RV-only park (no tents) on IL-37 by I-57 Exit 77 at Whittington, near Rend Lake; pool, store, meeting room, propane. Also rents monthly sites. Reservations are confirmed by phone. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates, policies, facilities, news), Google 4.7/399, RV Life 5 reviews (Sept-Nov 2026, $50-55), imagery. $45 back-in / $55 pull-through for two, 10% member discount (Good Sam, military etc.) brings $55 to $49.50; passes the gate on the $45 back-in. Year-round, water off at most sites in winter. Monthly sites exist but transient trade dominates the reviews. Phone 618-435-3401 (none stored). Pin is across IL-37, ~245 m east of the sites.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes. Cheapest site a 23-ft rig fits is the $45 full-hookup back-in; pull-throughs and premium back-ins are $55, $49.50 after the operator-posted 10% Good Sam/AAA/AARP/military/FMCA discount. RV Life reviewers paid $50-55 in Sept-Nov 2026. No gateway within 40 km. Not a directory Good Sam Park; good_sam written true from the operator's posted discount (schema §4.4).

LONG-STAY: 'We offer monthly sites, please call for information' and weekly rates, but no wording discourages nights; 399 Google reviews and the RV Life reviews read as overnighters and clubs. No site count published; imagery is all canopy, so the nightly share could not be measured. Not a candidate.
PIN: stored 38.07,-88.914 is on the east side of IL-37, ~245 m from the site loops. Suggested 38.0699,-88.9168 (centre of the wooded loops west of the office).
SEASON: year_round confirmed; the 2025 news says water is turned off at most sites after the season.
FEES: extra_person included 2 ('Rate Schedule for Party of Two'; no per-person amount posted); extra_vehicle $2.50 a night past one.
